Extent limits. Most tile areas use the span to the next indexed start and may include padding, data, or gaps. Internal gaps cannot be measured from this starts-only index. The map does not calculate a decompilation percentage or imply whole-game completion.
Selected report coverage. This view adapts S0 hotspot runtime, selected action-core, dependency, action-UI, and A-64 reports only. S01/S02/A28/A51 and coreCIF/HIFF/pixels report families are omitted and do not contribute to these counts.
Evidence classes stay separate. Solid teal marks complete functions matched from reviewed reconstructed x86 assembly in the accepted S08-2 and S08-3 families. Cyan outlines mark earlier partial exact ranges. C/C++ candidates still mismatch; bounded native-oracle comparisons and exported pseudocode remain separate evidence. Original C/compiler provenance and the whole executable rebuild are unverified.
